messages.subject: UT Austin Student Interested in Banking @ Citi (Referred by Miranda)

Hello Nicholas,

I hope you are doing well. I am emailing after coincidently learning from your sister (gf of my roommate) that you are an analyst at Citi. I am an undergraduate Economics & Business student at the University of Texas, and I'm pursuing a career in Investment Banking. Best,
Jonathan
